name: @pipeworx/mcp-wiktionary

tools.name: definition
tools.description: Parsed definitions grouped by part-of-speech sections.

tools.name: summary
tools.description: Fetch a plain-text summary extract of a Wiktionary entry (title, extract) for a word on the specified language subdomain (default en). Titles are case-sensitive.

tools.name: pronunciations
tools.description: IPA / phonetic transcriptions extracted from wikitext.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-wiktionary forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the wiktionary pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
